chunks: What is little yet sufficient is better than what is abundant and distracts.

key_terms.أَلْهَى: caused distraction and diverted from what matters
key_terms.كَفَى: was sufficient and met the need
key_terms.مَا قَلَّ: that which is little or small in amount

ai.seo_question: Why is a small but sufficient amount better than abundant wealth that distracts?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that a modest amount which fulfills one’s need is better than abundance that leads to distraction and heedlessness. It highlights an ethical preference for sufficiency, restraint, and freedom from worldly preoccupation.
